::: {style="max-width: 1100px; margin: 50px auto; text-align: justify;"}

I am currently a Research Contributor / Volunteer at Nimble Surgical, working on the development of computational methods for simulating auxetic metamaterials. Prior to this, I was a Faculty Research Assistant in the Intelligent Machines and Materials Lab, part of Collaborative Robotics and Intelligent Systems (CoRIS) Institute at Oregon State University. I developed hardware for integrating flexible electronics to underwater robots. My work sits at the intersection of mechanical design, robotics, and materials.

Outside of work, I am a virtual pilot and hobbyist photographer.

<style>
/* ── How I Work: diverge (Design) → three tracks → converge (Advanced Hardware) ── */
.flow-track {
  --accent: #FDD26E;
  --node-border: var(--border, #444);

  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1.2fr 0.6fr 1.3fr 0.6fr 1.3fr;
  align-items: stretch;          /* connectors span the full row height */
  gap: 0;
  margin: 18px 0 8px;
}

.flow-node {
  padding: 1.1rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--node-border);
  border-left: 2px solid var(--accent);
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
}
.flow-node--split,
.flow-node--merge { align-self: center; }

.flow-node__label { font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 0.35rem; }
.flow-node__sub   { font-size: 0.85rem; opacity: 0.78; text-align: left; }

/* equal-height rows: this is what makes the middle connector truly horizontal,
   since the centre node's midpoint then coincides with the column's centre */
.flow-branch {
  display: grid;
  grid-auto-rows: 1fr;
  gap: 1.2rem;
}

.flow-conn {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: block;
  opacity: 0;                    /* revealed once the paths are measured */
  transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
}
.flow-conn.is-ready { opacity: 1; }
.flow-conn path {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--accent);
  stroke-width: 1.4;
  opacity: 0.55;
  vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke;
}
/* the draw-on animation is applied per path in JS, since each one needs its
   own length and stagger delay */
.flow-conn path.is-drawing {
  transition: stroke-dashoffset 0.9s cubic-bezier(0.33, 0, 0.2, 1);
}

/* ── Focus Areas ── */
.focus-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
  gap: 14px;
  margin: 18px 0 8px;
}
.focus-card {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-end;
  min-height: 110px;
  padding: 1rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--border, #444);
  border-radius: 10px;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-decoration: none;
  color: inherit;
  transition: transform 0.25s ease, border-color 0.25s ease, background-color 0.25s ease;
}
.focus-card:hover,
.focus-card:focus-visible {
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  border-color: #FDD26E;
  background: rgba(253, 210, 110, 0.06);
}

/* ── Responsive: stack the flow, halve the grid ── */
@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .flow-track { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 1rem; }
  .flow-conn  { display: none; }
  .flow-node--split::after,
  .flow-branch::after {
    content: "\2193";
    display: block;
    margin-top: 1rem;
    text-align: center;
    color: #FDD26E;
    opacity: 0.6;
  }
  .focus-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .flow-conn  { transition: none; }
  .focus-card { transition: none; }
  .focus-card:hover { transform: none; }
}
</style>

<script>
(function () {
  // Each .flow-conn is drawn from the measured positions of the single node on
  // one side and every .flow-node in the .flow-branch on the other, so adding
  // or removing a track needs no coordinate edits here.
  const SVGNS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
  const conns = document.querySelectorAll(".flow-conn");
  if (!conns.length) return;

  const reduced = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
  let played = reduced;            // once true, paths render fully drawn

  function drawOne(svg) {
    const out    = svg.dataset.dir === "out";      // out: one → many, in: many → one
    const branch = out ? svg.nextElementSibling : svg.previousElementSibling;
    const single = out ? svg.previousElementSibling : svg.nextElementSibling;
    if (!branch || !single) return;

    const box = svg.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (!box.width || !box.height) return;         // hidden on mobile — nothing to draw

    const singleBox = single.getBoundingClientRect();
    const y0   = singleBox.top + singleBox.height / 2 - box.top;
    const midX = box.width / 2;

    svg.setAttribute("viewBox", `0 0 ${box.width} ${box.height}`);

    const frag = document.createDocumentFragment();
    branch.querySelectorAll(":scope > .flow-node").forEach(node => {
      const r  = node.getBoundingClientRect();
      const y1 = r.top + r.height / 2 - box.top;
      const [a, b] = out ? [y0, y1] : [y1, y0];    // start and end heights

      // within a pixel of level, draw a true straight line — a Bézier between
      // near-equal endpoints still renders a visible sag
      const d = Math.abs(a - b) < 1
        ? `M0,${a} L${box.width},${a}`
        : `M0,${a} C${midX},${a} ${midX},${b} ${box.width},${b}`;

      const path = document.createElementNS(SVGNS, "path");
      path.setAttribute("d", d);
      frag.appendChild(path);
    });

    svg.replaceChildren(frag);
    svg.classList.add("is-ready");

    // Hide each path along its own length so it can be "drawn" left to right.
    // getTotalLength needs the path in the document, hence the second pass.
    if (!played) {
      svg.querySelectorAll("path").forEach(p => {
        const len = p.getTotalLength();
        p.style.strokeDasharray  = len;
        p.style.strokeDashoffset = len;
      });
    }
  }

  // Reveal: paths run from x=0 to x=width, so easing the dash offset to zero
  // draws them in the direction of flow. Staggered per connector and per track.
  function play() {
    conns.forEach((svg, ci) => {
      svg.querySelectorAll("path").forEach((p, pi) => {
        p.classList.add("is-drawing");
        p.style.transitionDelay = `${ci * 0.35 + pi * 0.12}s`;
        p.style.strokeDashoffset = 0;
      });
    });
    played = true;
  }

  let queued = false;
  function draw() {
    if (queued) return;
    queued = true;
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {                  // measure after layout settles
      queued = false;
      conns.forEach(drawOne);
    });
  }

  draw();
  window.addEventListener("load", draw);           // re-measure once webfonts land

  // ResizeObserver catches column reflow, zoom and font swaps that a resize
  // listener alone would miss.
  const track = document.querySelector(".flow-track");
  if ("ResizeObserver" in window && track) {
    new ResizeObserver(draw).observe(track);
  } else {
    window.addEventListener("resize", draw);
  }

  // Draw the lines when the chart first scrolls into view — once per page load.
  if (!played && track) {
    if ("IntersectionObserver" in window) {
      const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries, obs) => {
        if (!entries[0].isIntersecting) return;
        obs.disconnect();                          // never runs a second time
        requestAnimationFrame(play);               // let the dash offsets commit first
      }, {threshold: 0.25});
      io.observe(track);
    } else {
      play();                                      // no observer support: just show them
    }
  }
})();
</script>

:::
